clips.send: A parent sends it to a fast-eating teen, mild anxiety, with a reason to chew more.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's reminder: a supplement is called that for a reason - it's meant to be in addition to food, never instead of it.

Your body runs on whole food, chewed slowly. Your stomach has no teeth, so swallowing instead of chewing puts digestion behind before it starts.

It's also why a whole orange beats a glass of juice: the fiber slows things down so the vitamin C is absorbed in the intestine, not wasted in the stomach.

Even animals in the wild just eat the fruit whole.

How many times did you chew your last bite?
